maddeler.e:
اغتفروا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَفَرُوا (iḡtafarū) /iɣ.ta.fa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اُغْتُفِرُوا (uḡtufirū) /uɣ.tu.fi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اِغْتَفِرُوا (iḡtafirū) /iɣ.ta.fi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
